supported_profile: Owner-private macOS/Linux hash-only feedback software, separate from public registry, research collection and moderation
original_required_acceptance: Deliver Reporting intake, hash-only. Next package action: Separate legacy hash-only registry proposal from consented research and organizational retention. Required outcome: Local tag processing exposes success and dependency failures explicitly.

acceptance_mapping.intake: Strict five-field feedback admission for the implemented PS/PII_REDACTED routes; preview never writes and each stored intake requires explicit consent.
acceptance_mapping.hash_only: No text, notes, identity, credentials, URLs, evidence positions or training labels accepted; input errors never echo private contents.
acceptance_mapping.success_and_failure: Actual store, count, metadata export, duplicate and capacity behavior; malformed schema, unsafe private files, extra fields and unknown tag/code refused.
acceptance_mapping.retention_and_withdrawal: Duplicate intake does not extend expiry; active access/prune logically deletes expired records; explicit ticket withdrawal and verified removal work. No powered-down wall-clock erasure or deletion of exported copies is claimed.
acceptance_mapping.durability: Actual killed uncommitted process rolls back and releases locks; three concurrent intake processes share one duplicate ticket.
acceptance_mapping.separation: No HTTP endpoint, public registry activation, company research forwarding, public moderation or organization-audit mutation; damaged inbox does not disable personal PS checking.

limitations: Private operator software only; public content reporting and moderation remain open under F-135/N-005.
Company research/real consenting pilot remains open under N-011/F-141; no actual user feedback was collected.
Hashes are linkable metadata; no source/content verification, anonymity, physical erasure or training-label validity is inferred.
schema_control: Actual extra-table and reserved-prefix trigger refusal execute before intake.
